thingsToDo.title: Explore University of Alaska Fairbanks
thingsToDo.description: The University of Alaska Fairbanks was founded in 1917 as the Alaska Agricultural College and School of Mines, years before Alaska became a state in 1959. Its main campus sits on a hill west of downtown Fairbanks and serves as the flagship research institution in the University of Alaska system. The university hosts major Arctic and geophysical research programs, including facilities linked to climate, aurora, and permafrost science in high-latitude environments. Enrollment, federal research partnerships, and specialized institutes have made the campus one of interior Alaska’s most important economic and educational anchors. Its founding date, institutional mission, and scientific output place it at the center of Fairbanks’ modern identity beyond military and pipeline-era development.
